== English errata comparison sources ==
The Players Committee changed the condition for the Force drain from cloud sectors on the same planet to related cloud sectors. The other effects and printed attributes match.

Aglets, Players Committee Rules Team, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1322117#p1322117 Current Rulings Archive], 25 November 2020, entry Kebyc.
